findings.title: The USER regions cannot add an executable opcode while obeying the frozen marker-only edit rule
evidence: template_contract.json defines user opcodes 3..2^OPCODE_WIDTH-1 and requires agents to edit only between matching USER markers.

rtl/cmd_dispatcher_template.sv:187-211 assigns fixed_opcode_w, command_legal_w and bank_eligible_w exclusively in a fixed always_comb that recognizes only END/MM2S/S2MM; USER_DECODE is after that block at lines 214-216.
rtl/cmd_dispatcher_template.sv:350-360 sends every command with fixed_opcode_w==0 directly to ERROR_DRAIN before any user issue path can be selected.

rtl/cmd_dispatcher_template.sv:241-295 exclusively drives both fixed request valids, request_fire_w, bank_acquire, bank_release and pending_any_w; USER_ISSUE and USER_COMPLETION follow this block and have no hook nets consumed by it.
rtl/cmd_dispatcher_template.sv:363-369 records only pending_mm2s_r or pending_s2mm_r after request_fire_w, and request_fire_w itself is only the OR of the two fixed DMA handshakes.

A separate always_comb or continuous assignment added inside USER_DECODE/USER_ISSUE to override these fixed-owned signals would create multiple drivers; defining fresh user signals does not affect the fixed FSM because it consumes no user hook.
findings.impact: A copied template cannot route a GEMM or any other user opcode through decode, eligibility, stable valid/ready issue, PC advance, pending tracking, completion and release without editing fixed code outside the USER markers. The artifact therefore fails its declared reusable-extension purpose even though the fixed DMA-only behavior passes.
findings.required_for_promotion: Provide single-driver extension hook signals or place editable user branches inside the owning decode/issue/completion/FSM processes, then add a real user-opcode fixture proving decode through exact-once release under backpressure and rerun all evidence.

findings.title: The executable structure gate and testbench validate marker presence, not marker usability
evidence: scripts/check_infrastructure_template.py checks exact marker count/order but has no semantic check that user decode, issue, pending or completion hooks feed the fixed FSM.
tb/tb_cmd_dispatcher_template.sv checks a constant USER_MARKER_COUNT sentinel and intentionally expects opcode 3 to fail; it instantiates no sample user executor or user opcode.
Fresh structure-gate and XSIM reruns therefore pass while P1-EXTENSION-DISCONNECTED remains present.
findings.impact: Future regressions can report PASS for a template that compiles but cannot be extended under its own contract.
findings.required_for_promotion: Extend the gate or add a disposable marker-only extension fixture that compiles and dynamically exercises one user opcode end to end.

promotion_decision: INELIGIBLE: one open P1 finding; PASS requires no P0, P1 or P2 findings

pinned_contract_and_structure_gate.notes: The reduced-framework executable gate passed exact identities, fixed ports and 14 markers once/in contract order. It does not test extension connectivity.

results: Separate native command-BRAM Port B is exposed as cmd_enb/cmd_addrb/cmd_doutb; command memory is not instantiated as a data bank.
No fixed GEMM port, s_axi slave port, AXI BRAM Controller, block-memory IP or read/write-split bank ownership interface is present.
Data bank 0 is legal and ownership uses unified bank_acquire/bank_release/bank_busy over [0:BANK_NUM-1].
END=0, MM2S=1 and S2MM=2 decode from the documented MSB-first record fields.
Bounds checks precede operand-bank and response-tag array indexing on reachable paths.
Default parameters are legal; derived width checks cover bank count, tag width, command latency, command count and record width.
MM2S/S2MM valid is state/opcode based and independent of ready; decoded payload remains registered-command stable until handshake.
Acquire, pending set and PC increment occur only on the selected valid-and-ready handshake.
Distinct-bank commands may remain concurrently outstanding; a busy current-bank command stalls without lookahead.
Bounds-checked typed response matching clears the matching pending entry and pulses one release independently of current PC.
END and error drain pending entries plus external bank_busy; the PC1023/1024-command missing-END bound is exercised.
Synchronous reset unconditionally clears state, PC, command, error and both fixed pending maps; output pulses are combinationally reset-gated.
fixed_protocol_and_functional_audit.limitation: No real user-opcode path exists or is tested. Same-cycle zero-latency completion coincident with first request acceptance is not specified or exercised; the fixed DMA use case naturally completes later.

user_parameter_marker.result: Although USER_PARAMETERS is in the module body rather than the ANSI parameter-port list, an actual marker-inserted parameter was accepted and named-overridden through instance #(.USER_TEST_PARAMETER(9)) by the pinned Verilator executable.

vivado_ooc.timing_exceptions_assessment: Legitimate for this OOC scope: only hold checks from unplaced external inputs and to unplaced external outputs are false-pathed; internal register-to-register hold paths remain timed. No placed/routed or external-I/O timing is claimed.

evidence_assessment.implementation_report_consistency: Hashes, fixed-path XSIM, lint, utilization, timing, DRC, methodology and no-blackbox claims reproduce.
evidence_assessment.overclaim: kernel_report.json describes USER regions as extension points but reports only marker presence and a compile sentinel; it does not establish that a user opcode can reach the fixed control path.

scope.validated: Reusable control template fixed END/MM2S/S2MM command-fetch, issue, tracking and drain behavior at module level, subject to the blocking extension finding.
not_validated: AXI BRAM Controller or address assignment
any GEMM or other user compute executor
